question: Which companies are most active in multiple myeloma? Please count J&J and Celgene programs correctly.

input.sql:
SELECT company_id, company_name, agency_class, area, n_trials, n_active_trials, n_active_readout_trials, n_assets, n_phase3_plus, n_phase2, n_phase1_or_earlier, latest_activity
FROM v_sponsor_activity
WHERE area ILIKE '%myeloma%' OR company_id IN ('johnson johnson janssen','bristol myers squibb')
ORDER BY n_active_trials DESC
LIMIT 30

SELECT p.lead_company_of_most_advanced AS company_id, c.company_name, c.agency_class,
       count(DISTINCT p.asset_id) AS n_programs,
       sum(CASE WHEN p.max_phase_active IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_active_programs,
       sum(p.n_trials) AS n_trials_total,
       sum(p.n_active_trials) AS n_active_trials_total
FROM v_programs p
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT company_id, company_name, agency_class FROM v_sponsor_activity) c
  ON c.company_id = p.lead_company_of_most_advanced
WHERE p.condition_key = 'D009101'
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY n_programs DESC
LIMIT 30

SELECT p.asset_id, a.canonical_name, p.max_phase_active, p.max_phase_ever, p.n_trials, p.n_active_trials
FROM v_programs p JOIN assets a USING (asset_id)
WHERE p.condition_key = 'D009101' AND p.lead_company_of_most_advanced = 'johnson johnson janssen'
ORDER BY p.max_phase_active DESC NULLS LAST, p.n_active_trials DESC

SELECT p.asset_id, a.canonical_name, p.max_phase_active, p.max_phase_ever, p.n_trials, p.n_active_trials
FROM v_programs p JOIN assets a USING (asset_id)
WHERE p.condition_key = 'D009101' AND p.lead_company_of_most_advanced = 'bristol myers squibb'
ORDER BY p.max_phase_active DESC NULLS LAST, p.n_active_trials DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT asset_id, canonical_name FROM assets WHERE canonical_name ILIKE '%lenalidomide%' OR canonical_name ILIKE '%pomalidomide%' OR canonical_name ILIKE '%revlimid%' OR canonical_name ILIKE '%pomalyst%'

SELECT p.asset_id, a.canonical_name, p.max_phase_active, p.max_phase_ever, p.n_trials, p.n_active_trials, p.lead_company_of_most_advanced
FROM v_programs p JOIN assets a USING (asset_id)
WHERE p.condition_key = 'D009101' AND p.asset_id IN ('lenalidomide','pomalidomide','revlimid','pomalyst','lenalomide')
ORDER BY p.n_trials DESC

SELECT s.company_id, s.company_name, count(DISTINCT ta.asset_id) AS n_assets_as_lead_or_collab, count(DISTINCT t.nct_id) AS n_trials
FROM v_trials t
JOIN trial_sponsors_norm s ON s.nct_id = t.nct_id AND s.sponsor_type='lead'
JOIN trial_assets ta ON ta.nct_id = t.nct_id AND ta.role IN ('subject','unknown')
JOIN trial_conditions_norm cn ON cn.nct_id = t.nct_id AND cn.condition_key='D009101'
WHERE s.company_id IN ('bristol myers squibb','johnson johnson janssen')
GROUP BY 1,2
